definitions.gloss: to be utterly dumbfounded; to be completely appalled; to be beyond amazed
definitions.explanation: An intensified form of {呆|あき}れる expressing extreme exasperation or disbelief at someone's behavior or a situation. Conveys that one has reached the absolute limit of astonishment or disgust.

examples.japanese: もう{呆|あき}れ{果|は}てた。
{彼|かれ}の{言|い}い{訳|わけ}に{呆|あき}れ{果|は}てた。
examples.english: I was completely dumbfounded by his excuses.

examples.japanese: {何度|なんど}{注意|ちゅうい}しても{直|なお}らないので、{呆|あき}れ{果|は}てて{何|なに}も{言|い}えなかった。
examples.english: No matter how many times I warned them they wouldn't change, so I was so appalled I couldn't say anything.

notes:
Compound of {呆|あき}れる (to be amazed/appalled) + {果|は}てる (to reach an extreme, used as an auxiliary verb indicating completion or exhaustion). The {果|は}てる suffix intensifies the meaning, expressing that one's astonishment has reached its absolute limit.

USAGE:
Almost always used in negative contexts — expressing disgust, exasperation, or disbelief at someone's foolishness, rudeness, or incompetence. Stronger than {呆|あき}れる alone. Often used in the past tense ({呆|あき}れ{果|は}てた) or て-form ({呆|あき}れ{果|は}てて).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {呆|あき}れ{果|は}てた{顔|かお} — a look of utter disbelief
- {呆|あき}れ{果|は}てて{物|もの}も{言|い}えない — so appalled one is speechless
- すっかり{呆|あき}れ{果|は}てる — to be completely and utterly dumbfounded

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {呆|あき}れる — to be amazed, appalled (base form, less intense)
- {唖然|あぜん}とする — to be struck dumb, speechless (focuses on being rendered speechless)
- {愕然|がくぜん}とする — to be shocked, stunned (stronger shock, can be positive or negative)
